summary: Rabbi Hidary explores why Megillat Esther lacks explicit mentions of Hashem's name and why key characters like Esther and Mordechai do not appear to pray or follow strict halakha in the text. He examines historical approaches including the Dead Sea sect's rejection of the book and Shmuel's Talmudic view on its status, alongside how the Septuagint and Rabbinic Midrashim add prayers and observance to fill these gaps.
questions: Why is Hashem's name missing from Megillat Esther?
Did Esther and Mordechai pray during the crisis?
How did ancient translations and Midrashim address the lack of religious observance in the text?
Why did some early Jewish groups and sages question the status of Megillat Esther?
